notes: Cross-verse consistency in the supplied English subject pronoun. Nine units of this chapter put a supplied subject word on the expressed Greek subject token and leave the finite verb its auxiliaries (1:5 ἐγώ/ἐγώ/αὐτός, 1:10 Σύ, 1:11 αὐτοί/σύ/πάντες, 1:12 σύ), and fourteen put it on the verb only where the Greek expresses no subject. This verse alone gave 'they' to εἰσίν while the expressed masculine nominative subject πάντες stood beside it, on the strength of the English inversion 'Are they' — which rules 53 and 63 refuse as a test. 'they' moves to πάντες, discontinuously around 'not' under rule 15, exactly as 1:11's πάντες → 'they all'. Every other unit, status and head is unchanged.
